items.description: Notify the relevant parties about the stoppage of VSL-01 due to the exhaust valve no.4 spindle seat leak, which occurred from 02:10 to 08:10 on 2026-10-10.
Prepare a claim and record evidence regarding the stoppage of VSL-01 for the exhaust valve no.4 repair, noting the duration of 6.0 hours on 2026-10-10.
